summary: 7 features and 3 fixes across HagiCode-org/hagicode-core, HagiCode-org/web.
bodyHtml:
Features

HagiCode-org/hagicode-core

  • session: add agent switch for stopped sessions (3b83ecd)
  • standard-words: add management API for editable project standard words (d4aab0a)

HagiCode-org/web

  • session: add stopped session agent switch dialog (0198f52)
  • hero: add trait enforcement priority hint to trait form (d9d507d)
  • vscode-server: integrate disabled state across all UI surfaces (a6de253)
  • vscode-server: add disabled state context and service guard (130c24d)
  • project: add standard words management tab (9eac361)

Fixes

HagiCode-org/web

  • mainlayout: improve MonoSpec detection to scan entire project list (4c1dca0)
  • settings: improve document theme panel and preview card UX and accessibility (ae25af8)
  • hero: improve dungeon rail preview image handling and i18n (ddd28e0)
